passages.provision_quote: The right to marry is a fundamental right.
passages.note: Bill text repeals the opposite-sex-only marriage provision and makes marriage a fundamental right with no discrimination-protection or religious-exemption clause.
Wiener voted Aye on ACA 5's single-subject Senate Floor final passage, 31-0.

rows.reasoning: Wiener voted Aye on ACA 5 (2023-2024)'s Senate Floor final passage (31-0, 07/13/23), a single-subject constitutional amendment whose operative text states 'the right to marry is a fundamental right,' repealing the prior man-woman-only provision. This matches the rung guaranteeing same-sex marriage 'the same benefits and protections as any other marriage'; the text adds no discrimination protections in jobs/housing (rung 1) and names no religious-organization carve-out (rung 3).
